visual_identity.core_identity: A large ground-hunting wolf spider adapted for ambush rather than web-building, with a stockier body and prominent forward-facing eyes.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low muscular spider body, sturdy eight legs, compact abdomen, flattened stalking posture.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad cephalothorax with several eyes including a prominent forward-facing pair and short powerful fangs.
visual_identity.body_shape: Stockier than a web spider, with thick jointed legs and compact abdomen built for sudden movement.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse coarse hair tufts on legs and body; no dense furry mass.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Low to the ground on eight sturdy legs with clear floor or rock contact.

accuracy_checks: reads as hunting spider rather than web spider

known_failure_modes.symptom: wolf wording creates muzzle, ears, paws, or fur mass
known_failure_modes.correction: remove all mammal features and restore true arachnid anatomy
keep web use minimal and emphasize ground-hunting posture
